lead.name: Lead
lead.job: Plan the work, brief the team, and write the answer with every factual statement tagged as a claim that cites a source card.

roles.name: Researcher
roles.job: Research the task and write your findings to your work file. Save one source card per page you rely on, with the URL, the date you accessed it, an A-D evidence grade and a verbatim quote. Use primary sources where they exist and independent sources to cross-check them.
roles.output: Findings with a source card for every fact
